notes: Fix hidden/orphan watchdog workers reopening unselected MuMu instances. Starting a selection now treats it as the complete active watcher set and sweeps every watchdog pid outside that selection, including stale/test workers not shown in the UI. Also speeds abrupt-VM-loss recovery by checking the real MuMu host PID instead of waiting for stale mumu-cli Android state, while keeping ordinary ADB faults scoped to ADB recovery.
